flows.title: Create a post in a post space
steps: This page is Circle's sign-in page. Once signed in, open your community; every step below happens there.
Head to the post space from the sidebar and click New post.
Click the Title field and write a title for the post.
Click anywhere in the body of the post editor to write. Type / to open the menu of formatting options, or select text to bring up the formatting bar.
To add a cover image, click the Add cover icon at the top of the editor, choose or upload an image, and click Save.
To assign topics, click the selection bar at the bottom of the editor and select up to five.
Click Publish to make the post live in the space right away. Admins and moderators can instead click the dropdown beside Publish and select Save draft, or Schedule post and set a date and time.
